wallet.pera_defly_mentioned: Fallback in App.tsx handleWalletConnect checks window.algorand for Pera/Defly; primary flow uses WalletManager with Lute + WalletConnect
wallet.connection_flow: User opens WalletConnectModal -> clicks wallet -> wallet.connect() or parent onConnect(walletType); on success modal closes and activeAccount set by WalletProvider
wallet.signing_apis: signTransactions(txns: Uint8Array[]) from useWallet(); returns signed txns for submit
wallet.account_switching_behavior: TBD (use-wallet-react provides activeAccount; explicit switch UI not present in codebase)

transactions.atomic_group_builder_location: External: Swap-API returns unsignedTransactions (base64). Frontend does not build groups; decodes base64 to Uint8Array[] and passes to signTransactions
transactions.fee_funding_mbr_handling: TBD (assumed handled by Swap-API / backend; no explicit MBR or fee logic in frontend)
transactions.slippage_enforcement: Slippage sent in quote request (appConfig.ui.defaultSlippageTolerance, default 0.01); enforcement is on Swap-API/contract side
transactions.confirmation_tracking: algosdk.waitForConfirmation(algodClient, res.txid, 4) in SwapInterface.tsx after sendRawTransaction
transactions.retry_error_logic: try/catch in handleSwap; WalletConnect session expiry detected by message (session/no session found) and user prompted to reconnect; no automatic retry

indexing.indexer_endpoints: None in frontend. No Algorand indexer used; pool/token data from static config and quote from Swap-API
